stats.text:
You always have the *{ref:spell/hunters-mark}* spell prepared. You can cast it twice without expending a spell slot, and you regain all expended uses of this ability when you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest}.

The number of times you can cast the spell without a spell slot increases when you reach certain Ranger levels, as shown in the Favored Enemy column of the Ranger Features table.
